_README: Passes whose own metas can no longer be priced (a cleanup leg overwrote the main meta, so the tokens of the leg it cleaned up are gone) and which therefore carry the figure their post-run report published, with cost_basis 'published' (PI ruling D13, planning/pi-decisions-2026-09-20.md).
